prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: side impact at intersection in Pearland, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported concussion. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1370; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- It is not fully clear where in the vehicle the claimant was sitting.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling through the intersection on a green signal when Driver 2 entered from the cross street and struck the driver side of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 2 stated that the vehicle did not stop fully before entering the intersection. A passenger was also present in Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 reported being dazed after the impact and complained of a concussion, though it remains unclear whether the reported injury resulted from this collision. It is also not fully established which seat within the vehicle Driver 1 occupied at the time of impact. Witness statements, scene photographs, and the account given by Driver 2 all agree with the sequence of events described by Driver 1. The damage visible on both vehicles is largely consistent with the reported angle and force of the impact. Officers found no indication of prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. Medical evaluation was recommended at the scene and Driver 1 was transported for further assessment.
